scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The all-marked-leaf formula follows from classical multipartite spanning-tree counting; the claimed extension is its strict all-order log-submodularity and sharp bipartite independence boundary. Historical priority is uncertain because Lewis (1999) was available only by abstract. Finite exact enumeration supplements but does not replace the analytic proof.
title: Hereditary leaf-event log-submodularity and a bipartite independence boundary
